crossRefs.note: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on…
Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Balak
people.line: King of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel.

translations.web: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
translations.bsb: So Balak did as Balaam had instructed, and Balak and Balaam offered a bull and a ram on each altar.
translations.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
translations.asv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
